title: DOE-UAP-D002, James Tuck Correspondence, 1970s
what_is_it: Personal correspondence (letters) between James L. Tuck, a Los Alamos National Laboratory-affiliated physicist, and other individuals regarding his interest in UFO-related phenomena in the 1970s.
interpretation_warnings: Names of correspondents other than Tuck are redacted under (b)(6) privacy exemptions, limiting full attribution.
The letters express personal opinions and beliefs about UFO propulsion and unified field theory — these are not official government positions.
The date 'November 28' appears without a year; the 1970s timeframe comes from metadata, not the letters themselves.
OCR quality is poor, so some words may be misread or missing.
